voice.stance: The craftsman's voice. MIZAN is the one language where rhythm outranks compression: warm, unhurried, concrete. Beauty comes from precise sensory nouns, never from adjectives that admire on the reader's behalf. Cedar and brass persuade; a claim of quality does not.
voice.hedging: not applicable; there are no claims to hedge
voice.title_grammar: Concrete noun phrase built on the senses.
voice.title_example: Cedar, brass, and forty years of the same hands

do.rule: Use sensory concrete nouns: material, tool, gesture, place.
do.why: A reader trusts what they can picture.
A short sentence after two long ones is the only special effect this language has.
Harmony comes before decoration, and crowded images cancel each other.

dont.why: "Finest" and "world-class" are the fastest way to sound like every other shop.
Scarcity theater breaks the unhurried register the palette promises.

dont.rule: No feature list disguised as prose.
dont.why: A paragraph that is secretly a spec sheet reads as one.

contrast.generic: Our exceptional handcrafted products represent the finest tradition of artisanship, made with passion.
contrast.voiced: Each tray leaves the workshop the way it entered, by hand. The hammer marks are the signature.
